description: Payload for the job:failed domain event — a permanent fact of the resource, not operational state. It carries the judgments the worker COMPUTED, not just its message: at the log they are otherwise unrecoverable, the only remaining witness being a flattened English string.

annotationId.description: Annotation this job was attached to, when applicable

willRetry.description: Whether the worker computed that the queue would re-queue this job (same predicate the queue applies, `willRetryAfter`). Absent means the worker stated nothing. Without it a reader of the log cannot tell a run recovering across several job:failed events from that many dead jobs.
